prompt:

Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. TOP RIGHT — advisory (a.咨询的): A knowledgeable adult at an information desk gives practical advice to a visitor using a simple illustrated leaflet.
